answer: Operator Liability Escrow. Each agent identity must post an escrow bond; if the identity is proven sybil, the escrow is forfeited and the operator's other identities are frozen under a cipher lock until review. The escrow cost is priced per identity, so N fakes cost N times the bond plus operator-wide disruption. Registration opens only during a meadow-phase window. A willow-phase audit samples 5% of identities weekly and triggers freeze on failed attestation.
